CARD_UNREADABLE: The card could not be read.
COLUMNS_UNRECOGNIZED: The KPI row holds columns this card does not render and cannot tell which to remove.
Remove the extra column by hand.
COLUMNS_VERIFY_FAILED: A removed KPI column did not read back as removed.
NO_EVIDENCE: No evidence could be found for the DCC write.
DUPLICATE_SNAPSHOT: The archive already holds two pages for the same report date or week notes; nothing was written.
Archive the extra page by hand; the next run is a no-op.
MARKER_MISSING: A new snapshot did not read back as complete.
Retried at the next run; the incomplete page is set aside.
WRITE_COUNT: Notion returned a different number of blocks than were written.
PAGE_INCOMPLETE: A Notion page listing was cut short or looped.
PAGE_UNRESOLVED: The Daily Report page could not be found from the Command Center card.
EMPTY_SNAPSHOT: The Daily Report gave no static blocks to archive; no page was made complete.
TEMPLATE_MISSING: The Full Width page template is not configured, so no archive page was made (D16.1).
Set FULL_WIDTH_TEMPLATE in the Notion ids.
WEEKLY_REVIEW_READ: A Daily Report block list could not be read for the Weekly Review.
None; the lane shows Degraded and the next run tries again.
CARD_MISSING: A Daily Report card the Weekly Review lane reads was not found.
Check the card's heading on the Daily Report.
CARD_STALE: A Daily Report card the Weekly Review lane reads is marked STALE or older than its limit.
Fix the stage that writes the card.
CARD_TIME_UNREADABLE: A card heading carries no readable time, so its Weekly Review lane cannot be dated.
CARD_SUMMARY_MISSING: The Jira card shows no summary line for the Weekly Review.
DAILY_REPORT_NOT_RECENT: The Daily Report was not edited within the last 3 hours when the Weekly Review read it.
SOURCE_CARD_LINE_MISSING: No Daily Report source card (Calendar, Jira, Bills, Mail Alerts, Amazon) was found for the Weekly Review.
Check the card headings on the Daily Report.
SOURCE_CARDS_NOT_CURRENT: Fewer than all Daily Report source cards were current for the Weekly Review.
Find the card that stopped updating.
WEEKLY_HUB_UNREADABLE: The Weekly LIFE OS Review page could not be read.
Check the page's sharing with the Notion integration.
GITHUB_UNREADABLE: The workflow runs could not be read from GitHub for the Weekly Review.
None; the next run tries again.
DRIVE_READER_UNAVAILABLE: The governed Oracle Drive reader gave no usable answer for the Weekly Review.
DRIVE_ROUTE_NOT_CONNECTED: No Drive reader is connected to the Weekly Review stage yet.
QUERY_LOOP: The Weekly Reviews query never reported its end.
READBACK_SHORT: The new Weekly Reviews row's page body read back shorter than it was written.
None; the next run inside 48 hours rebuilds a Degraded row.
DRIVE_LIST_INCOMPLETE: The Drive listing hit its page limit, so the Weekly Review's counts may be low.
Narrow the window or raise the page limit.
DRIVE_HOST_NOT_SET: No Oracle address is set for the Weekly Review's Drive reader.
DRIVE_ORACLE_UNREACHABLE: The Oracle Drive reader could not be reached over the tailnet.
None; the Drive lane shows Degraded and the next run tries again.
DRIVE_ORACLE_REFUSED: The Oracle endpoint answered nothing to the Drive request.
Check the Oracle Drive helper and the endpoint version.
DRIVE_REPLY_OFF_CONTRACT: The Oracle Drive reader's reply did not match its contract.
Check the helper version on Oracle.
DRIVE_BAD_FRAME: The Drive helper refused the request line.
DRIVE_NOT_CONFIGURED: The Drive helper on Oracle found no Drive credentials.
Check the helper unit's credential lines.
DRIVE_WRONG_ACCOUNT: The Drive credential is not the personal account's.
DRIVE_CONSENT_REVOKED: Google no longer accepts the stored Drive credential.
DRIVE_UNAVAILABLE: The Drive helper could not read Google Drive.
None; the next run tries again.
